findings.quoted_text: All amounts owed to Agent hereunder are due within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Delinquent payments are subject to a late payment charge of one and one half percent (1.5%) per month commencing sixty (60) days from the invoice date.

All amounts owed to Agent hereunder are due within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Delinquent payments are subject to a late payment charge of one and one half percent (1.5%) per month commencing sixty (60) days from the invoice date.
findings.explanation: Although invoices are payable within 30 days, late payment charges do not begin to accrue until 60 days from the invoice date, forcing Agent to wait an extra month before applying financial disincentives for late payment.
findings.suggested_change: Revise the clause so that late payment charges commence immediately upon the due date (30 days from the invoice date).

findings.quoted_text: In the event any federal, state or local laws, rules or regulations are enacted that require Agent to (i) make any adjustments and/or modifications to its current system, or (ii) provide additional services to Client for which Agent is not being compensated hereunder, then Client shall compensate Agent (a) on a pro rata basis proportionate to the Client's registered shareholder base, for the costs associated with making such required adjustments and/or modifications, or (b) according to Agent's standard fees established, in good faith, with respect to such additional services.
findings.explanation: Compensating Agent on a pro-rata basis for mandatory system adjustments or new regulatory services may undercompensate Agent if the client's share of the registered shareholder base is small relative to the actual development or compliance costs incurred.
findings.suggested_change: Propose that Client pay its applicable standard fee or full cost recovery for custom system adjustments required by new laws rather than a pro-rata share that may not cover total costs.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the paperwork. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a minor adjustment regarding the relevant clause: - Although invoices are payable within 30 days, late payment charges do not start until 60 days, which delays financial disincentives for late payment. I propose revising the clause so that late payment charges commence immediately upon the due date, 30 days from the invoice date. Thank you for your understanding. Best regards,
